title: Extreme Optimized +
body:
- **Sodium**: Rendering optimization, significantly increases FPS.

- **Lithium**: Improved game logic.

- **FerriteCore**: Reduced memory utilization.

- **Starlight**: Rewrites the lighting system to improve performance.

- **Entity Culling**: Skips rendering of objects not visible to the player.

- **Iris Shaders**: Shader pack loader for Minecraft.

- **Dynamic FPS**: Reduce resource usage while Minecraft is in the background, idle, or on battery.

- **LazyDFU**: Defers unnecessary initialization work so that it is only performed if required

- **Threadtweak**: Improve and tweak Minecraft CPU scheduling

- **ImmediatelyFast**: Improves the immediate mode rendering performance of the client.
